title: Domain wall dynamics in trilayer sliding ferroelectric γ -InSe
title_zh: 三层滑移铁电γ-InSe中的畴壁动力学
summary: 工作对象是三层γ-InSe滑移铁电中的畴壁运动，核心问题与层间滑移诱导极化及畴壁迁移直接相关。现有摘要未说明采用第一性原理、分子动力学还是有效哈密顿量，也未给出驱动方式和能垒。因缺少正文数据，无法判断其对畴壁速度、稳定性或器件尺度极化翻转的最强定量结论。其潜在价值在于补足二维滑移铁电从静态极化到动力学过程的计算描述。
abstract: npj Computational Materials, Published online: 29 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41524-026-02296-3 Domain wall dynamics in trilayer sliding ferroelectric γ -InSe

title: Wafer‐Scale Hyper‐Porous Graphene Network With Intrinsic Ferromagnetism at Room‐Temperature
title_zh: 室温本征铁磁的晶圆级超多孔石墨烯网络
summary: 核心对象是晶圆级超多孔石墨烯网络，创新点在于将大面积多孔碳网络与室温本征铁磁性结合。输入未说明孔径、缺陷类型、磁矩来源或磁性测试方法，也没有给出磁转变温度和饱和磁化强度。该工作若能排除杂质磁性，将与低维磁性和缺陷诱导磁序相关，但现有信息不足以评价其理论机制或可计算性。对团队的直接方法学价值暂不能确认。

title: Bridging experiment and theory: structural, magnetic, and electronic insights into cobalt and nickel substituted barium hexaferrite
title_zh: 钴镍取代钡六方铁氧体的结构磁性与电子性质
summary: 工作围绕Co和Ni取代Ba六方铁氧体，重点是结构变化、磁序和电子结构之间的联系。题目信息显示其尝试连接实验与理论，但未说明采用DFT、超胞、特殊准随机结构或磁性测量，也没有报告磁化强度和带隙变化。它与团队的磁性材料设计、自旋哈密顿量和高通量筛选有主题交叉，但现阶段不能判断是否涉及复杂自旋相互作用或磁电耦合。

title: Nanofibrous aerogels with continuous conductivity gradient for ultrabroadband absorption-dominant electromagnetic interference shielding
title_zh: 连续电导梯度纳米纤维气凝胶的超宽带吸收型电磁屏蔽
summary: 核心创新是把连续电导梯度引入芳纶纳米纤维/聚吡咯气凝胶，使阻抗渐变并降低自由空间失配导致的反射。制备采用单步扩散驱动氧化聚合，材料为轻质全聚合物网络。输入没有给出频率范围、屏蔽效能、反射和吸收占比等定量结果。与团队的直接交叉限于功能材料模拟和界面输运，未显示涉及电子结构、缺陷或量子材料。
abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 29 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77257-x Electromagnetic interference shields can be limited by impedance mismatch with free space, leading to strong reflections and secondary radiation. Here, the authors introduce lightweight all-polymer aerogels with a continuous through-thickness conductivity gradient, fabricated in a single step via diffusion-driven oxidative polymerization of pyrrole within aramid-nanofiber scaffolds.

title: Fabrication of High Magnetic Susceptibility Nano‐FeS2 via Electronic Reconstruction Induced by Alternating Magnetic Field
title_zh: 交变磁场电子重构制备高磁化率纳米FeS2
summary: 工作将交变磁场用于纳米FeS2制备或调控，核心主张是电子重构带来高磁化率。摘要未说明磁场频率、强度、处理时间、粒径、相组成及磁性测试结果，也没有给出电子重构的谱学或计算证据。它与团队的磁性材料、缺陷电子结构和有限磁场效应存在潜在主题交叉，但目前不能判断是否涉及交换作用、自旋-晶格耦合或可迁移理论模型。

title: Parity-doublet spin interactions in ultracold polyatomic molecules
title_zh: 超冷多原子分子中的宇称双重态自旋相互作用
summary: 核心问题是利用宇称双重态实现超冷多原子分子内部态的极化、共磁计和偶极交换控制。给定摘要只说明研究精密测量中的态制备与相关分子态保持，未说明具体分子、实验谱线、哈密顿量参数或交换动力学数据。该主题属于超冷分子和基础精密测量，和团队的材料自旋哈密顿量、磁性固体及AI材料模拟没有直接材料交叉。其方法迁移价值目前无法定量评估。
abstract: Precision measurements exploit internal molecular structure to search for physics beyond the Standard Model [1–6]. Reaching the entanglement-enhanced regime requires preparing and preserving correlated molecular states within the same manifold used for sensing [7–10]. Parity-doublet states are central to proposals for precision measurements with polyatomic molecules because they enable large molecular polarization for enhanced sensitivity and provide internal-state co-magnetometry to suppress systematic errors [1–3, 5, 6, 11]. Here we report the observation and control of resonant dipolar exchange interactions in a parity-doublet sensing manifold of ultracold polyatomic molecules. Using laser-cooled CaOH molecules in a crossed optical dipole trap, we encode a pseudospin in the ℓ-type parity-doublet states and observe two complementary signatures of interactions: a density-dependent Ramsey contrast decay and a spin-projection-dependent mean-field precession whose sign reverses with the initialized population imbalance. Both observables are well described by a common discrete truncated Wigner model [12–14] using independently calibrated experimental parameters. We further Floquet-engineer the interaction anisotropy and observe suppressed many-body dephasing near the SU(2)-symmetric Heisenberg point, identifying a protected regime relevant for spin squeezing and precision measurement with dense molecular ensembles [15–17]. Our results establish parity doublets as a coherent, interacting and programmable molecular degree of freedom, connecting the polyatomic precision-measurement platform to dipolar many-body physics and opening a route to entanglement-enhanced tests of fundamental physics.

title: Presynaptic Optical Modulation Enabled by Dielectric‐Embedded Type‐II PbS/PbSe Quantum Dots for Near‐Infrared Neuromorphic Vision
title_zh: 介电封装II-VI量子点实现近红外神经形态视觉
summary: 工作将PbS/PbSe量子点与介电封装结合，用于近红外神经形态视觉中的突触前光调制。题目信息支持的创新点是介电环境与量子点光电响应的器件耦合，但没有给出能级排列、载流子俘获机制、光谱范围或突触权重变化数据。它与团队的低维光电材料、界面电荷转移和非绝热载流子动力学存在潜在交叉，不过当前无法判断是否有第一性原理或动力学计算。

title: Agent-Driven Multi-View Facial Prior Learning for Identity-Preserving Pose-Guided Generation
title_zh: 智能体驱动的多视角人脸先验学习
summary: ADF-Pose针对大幅头部姿态变化下的人脸身份保持，核心创新是引入多视角身份先验和智能体驱动的生成流程。摘要仅明确IDPE与多模态身份模块，未说明骨干网络、损失函数、训练策略或基准结果。该工作属于计算机视觉生成模型，与凝聚态物理和材料AI没有直接交叉。除了一般的表示学习思想外，无法建立团队材料模拟方法、物理约束或电子结构计算的真实联系。
abstract: Pose-guided person image generation aims to synthesize a reference person in a target pose while preserving appearance and identity. However, existing methods mainly rely on global appearance representations and pay limited attention to facial identity information, making facial identity difficult to preserve under large changes in head pose. To address this problem, we propose ADF-Pose, an Agent-Driven Multi-View Facial Prior Learning framework for Identity-Preserving Pose-Guided Generation, which consists of two key modules: the Identity Prior Extractor (IDPE) and the Multimodal Identity Converter (MIDC). Specifically, IDPE reasons about missing facial views through structured topological directives, verifies the synthesized priors, and extracts view-specific identity descriptions. MIDC employs Dual Cross-Attention Fusion (DCAF) to align the verified visual priors with semantic descriptions and adapt the fused identity representation to the current denoising latent. This process supplements cross-view facial evidence when the reference view is incomplete and preserves identity-sensitive cues during denoising. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework, we conduct extensive experiments on the DeepFashion and Market-1501 datasets. Experimental results show that ADF-Pose outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, especially in preserving identity fidelity and fine-grained facial details under large pose variations.
